errors.evidence: This information about the specific task (Chinese FrameNet semantic role labeling) is not present in the figure itself; it is likely taken from the paper's title or surrounding text, which constitutes an interpretation beyond the visual data provided.

The description translates 'FP' as '伪误报率' (False Positive Rate). However, the y-axis values are large integers (1500-3000), which strongly suggest that FP represents a count of false positives, not a rate. Describing it as a rate is an unsubstantiated interpretation.
The starting value of the solid line at x=1 is significantly higher than 2600. It is more than halfway between 2500 and 3000, approximately 2700.

The description incorrectly identifies the location and value of the minimum point. The minimum occurs at x=13, not x=15. The value at x=13 is slightly above 2000, while the value at x=15 is approximately 2500.
The peak value at x=20 is significantly underestimated. The line reaches a value very close to 3000, not 2800. The reference description states the value is 2973.
The value of the solid line at x=30 is visibly above 2500, approximately at 2600. Stating it ends at 2500 is an underestimate.
